image_description: A close-up of a baby bib featuring a white terry cloth upper section and a yellow floral patterned lower pocket. The bib has a rounded neck hole with a visible snap fastener at the top center. A semi-circular pocket is stitched onto the front, decorated with large yellow flowers and white dots on a yellow background.

The snap fastener at the top appears slightly fused into the fabric collar rather than sitting distinctly on top; the metallic reflection is ambiguous and lacks clear mechanical definition.
